review_method: candidate full render sampled across timeline
reference real frames sampled across timeline via Transcriptor

major_faults.finding: Characters are too small in most compositions; they read as diagram labels rather than performers.
major_faults.repair: Use close/medium shots; characters should often occupy 25-60% of frame height.

major_faults.finding: Repeated centered boxes/panels create slide-deck/dashboard grammar.
major_faults.repair: Remove boxed UI as scene structure; build spatial scenes/environments.

major_faults.finding: Stick figures have minimal pose/emotion changes and rarely drive the scene.
major_faults.repair: Every spoken beat needs visible intention, reaction, contact, failure, recovery, or movement.

major_faults.finding: Backgrounds are mostly empty dark fields with lines; little environmental storytelling.
major_faults.repair: Use scene-specific locations, depth layers, furniture/props, foreground occlusion, and contextual details.

major_faults.finding: Framing is mostly static wide shots.
major_faults.repair: Use closeups, inserts, over-shoulders, push-ins, snap reframes, motivated cuts, and perspective changes.

major_faults.finding: Large headings/captions carry too much meaning and make scenes feel like presentation graphics.
major_faults.repair: Text becomes impact-only; visuals must communicate before text appears.

major_faults.finding: Objects change position, but motion rarely creates believable physical action.
major_faults.repair: Animate anticipation, acceleration, collision, recoil, secondary motion, recovery, and character reaction.

major_faults.finding: Long stretches repeat one visual setup while narration continues.
major_faults.repair: New staging/problem/reversal every few seconds, not just new labels.

major_faults.finding: Overall frame language is far from supplied viral references and top YouTube animation channels.
major_faults.repair: Require direct frame-by-frame parity review before full render.

major_faults.finding: Narration source contains non-dialogue production cues/SFX language.
major_faults.repair: Generate narration from dialogue-only script; keep SFX/music in separate tracks that never enter TTS.

next_gate.name: V5 opening proof
requirements: explicit PASS on every hard-fail dimension
